text.tspan: An inline SVG you build with the model instead
of upload — the grid overlay is the shared 10%
coordinate frame you and the model both work
in. The same canvas mechanism draws the
Two tabs the model keeps in sync as it works:
vocabulary is for you — what the drawing is —
and implementation notes are the model's own
record of ids, structure, and conventions.
Every request and reply lives here — there's
no separate version list because the chat
itself is the revision log. Scroll up to see
how the drawing got to where it is.
Describe what you want in plain language —
“draw a round green face with two eyes” — and
send it. The canvas, the vocabulary, and any
lint findings all update in place.
